decisions: A MenuIcon with no action is inert: MenuService returns before playing its configured sound.
Menu clicks are scheduled through ServerAdapter.runOnPlayerNextTick: Bukkit adapters defer to the next main-thread tick, Folia uses the player entity scheduler.
clickLater captures the current MenuHandle before scheduling and rechecks identity before acting, so deferred clicks cannot hit a replacement menu or a closed menu.
MenuService.click remains synchronous for direct service tests; only MenuListener supplies the scheduling boundary.
Added Paper and Spigot MenuAdapterContract coverage for create/open/update/close/offline/cancelled-open/sound/deferred work.
Added a renderer test against shipped claim.yml and updated WarningKindsTest to include MenuWarning.
Inventory titles remain untruncated because the targeted 1.18.2 API check found no 32-character limit; no title warning or truncation was added.
Shipped resources were limited to the four paging keys in en.yml, vi.yml, and zh.yml plus MENU_LAYOUT_ITEM_MISSING: high in warnings.yml.
